I am old now, 51 years, and I farm this small piece of land here in Thyolo with my family. The land is ours, which is good, but the maize plot is small — only a little less than half a hectare — so I must use it well. If I get the coupon from FISP this year I will put some fertilizer, maybe one bag of NPK at planting and one bag of urea later, and I always put the manure from my goats because the soil here is tired. I plant hybrid seed when I can get it from the subsidy, and I intercrop with pigeon pea and beans like we always do; I cannot afford pesticides and there is no irrigation here, we wait for the rains.
